rebuild_note: recomputed by integration/model.py after the 2026-11-13 settlement and the 11/14 05:00 AM injury edition; stamp = latest activity in data/live/capture_meta.json

hca_points.unit: points added to the home margin
hca_points.status: ASSUMPTION, not measured here. Estimating it from the out-of-sample games would be fitting on the test window, so it is held fixed and swept at 0.0 / 2.5 / 5.0 on the Gates page instead.

b2b_penalty.unit: points taken off a team on the second night of a back-to-back
b2b_penalty.status: ASSUMPTION. The back-to-back flag is official (it is read off the schedule); the size of the penalty is not measured. Swept at 0.0 / 2.0 / 4.0.

absence_points_per_minute_share.unit: margin points surrendered per 1.0 of team-minute share vacated by a NEW absence
absence_points_per_minute_share.status: ASSUMPTION. The minute share is built from official season minutes and games played; the conversion to points is not measured — no lineup or on/off data is reachable from this sandbox. Swept at 0.0 / 0.35 / 0.70.

sigma_game_points.used_for: the win probabilities on the graded games. The live slate's probabilities instead divide by the measured out-of-sample error σ, because once the error is known it is the honest scale. The two are not interchangeable and the difference is quantified in integration/out/transform_test.json: on this window a normal link near σ=11–12 out-scores the measured error-σ, so what costs accuracy here is the link function in scripts/build_edge_site.py, not the size of σ.
sigma_game_points.unit: points, single-game scoring noise used to set the shrinkage constant
sigma_game_points.status: ROUND NUMBER, deliberately conservative. A larger noise term shrinks team ratings harder, so this choice makes the model less bold, not more. The realised out-of-sample spread is measured below and printed beside it.

sigma_margin.status: MEASURED from the official final scores in the out-of-sample window (60 games, 2026-11-06 .. 2026-11-13). Small sample; the number moves whenever the window grows.

price.status: ABSENT. No sportsbook price is reachable from this sandbox. Therefore there is no break-even price, no closing-line value, no ROI, no Kelly stake and no market-consensus gate. Every 'pick' on this desk is a paper forecast graded against the final score, not against a price.
